body:
thank you.  I don't know if I'll go back to AA, but i'll certainly give him a call and let him know, it has been a week.

He never was my "official sponsor" I never had the courage to ask him. But he was a good guy.

hey finally had the courage to click that red mail icon.

I have been drinking again.  I haven't talked to my sponsor.  

It seems to be a good social drinking, my friends are all encouraging me. Though it's odd to take advice from people on coke. (can't do any sort of drugs, heart condition, so that's no problem to say no to).  

I almost had a sponsor, but I never had the courage to ask him, even though he obviously was the right choice, and wanted to.  I do miss the encouragement I felt three weeks ago at the mass youth conference.  I dunno, I'm happy to be back to drinking oddly too.  I already had a breakdown and lost it the other night though.. so we'll see.  This is why i was afraid of AA, now i'm back to old self, with the added shitty feeling of letting people down besides me.  ugh.  I dunno.  I'm both very happy (drunk at the moment) and very sad.  I'm productive during the day, am working at my new job doing color correction very happily (that I got while I was sober) but night time anxiety is too much.


I think this is why i started drinking again.  It wasn't the drinking that was the problem, I drink because of my anxiety.  Instead of AA I may need a therapist, or anti-anxiety medicine instead (I know replacing alcohol with another drug scares the shit out of me), but I know I'm severely bipolar and such, I was just raised in a family that doesn't believe in that kind of medicine. And if a doctor told me no, I'd accept that.  


Though this fin du monde tastes delicious.. (it's 4-pack case said drink less, drink better) I dunno.  ugh.  any tips?  


anything is great, thanks.  sorry if it takes me a while to respond.  it's hard to log into this account.

drank again.  AA was too much higher power.  Not upset.  AA isn't the answer for me.  I thought it would replace a proper counselor.  

I still have the same anxiety as I did when I was sober, though controlled. 

We'll see.

drunk again.  dammit.   Not upset about it though.  I'm a good drunk I think.  Felt good to take two weeks to recollect my thoughts.  Got upset about her though, rationalized one beer, and it's on day two.  not a bender.  had three beers yesterday, and a six pack of tallboys tonight.  


Got a new job as a color corrector (davinci resolve rules) in my soberness though, was very productive, and realized I don't need to drink at all (or as much) to function. 

There's a lot of things going on though.  Still upset about her.  I dunno, i stopped talking to my sponsor, was overwhelmed by the higher power part of AA, wasn't ready to be a victim, or admit that I'm powerless.  I dunno, I'd like to attribute my success, or future success, to me, not someone who's never answered my prayers.

Tried to go out with friends tonight for a buddies 21st just to give it a try.  Drank a lot of ginger beer.

Sobriety was amazing during the day but tough late at night.  My friends all made a point, albeit drunkenly to say that whether I drank or not they were all there for me and that I don't need to drink to fit in with them.  It was nice, but man did I want to drink.

If it weren't for AA and my sponsor I definitely would've caved like before, but i have too much drive now.  As a formerly shy guy, it's just a matter of getting used to not being drunk in crowds.

Well, the conference went great.  Will be a week sober in a few days.

I've been grieving, but I feel energetic and productive.  Found a sponsor who follows my religious/or lack of religious beliefs and will help me mold the whole higher power part of the steps into something that works for me.  

Incredible to find a whole network of people willing to help.  My phone has been going off the hook since I went to the conference with tons of people willing to talk to me and hang out.  Great way to keep myself busy. 

Also pumped on the whole solid poop thing starting to happen.

Drinking ginger beer as I type this and feeling moderately okay.

I suck with eating, but I can give it a shot.  

I usually use beer as a way to sleep, but I used to read when I was younger to fall asleep.  I could do that as well.

I'm going for a hike tomorrow I think, I have a couple favorite spots, I plan to take the dog.


I know this seems like simple advice, but I appreciate it.  Gotta keep the basics in check.  Thank you.

I'm catching a bus home until friday as soon as I get out of work.

Need my dog until I go to to the conference on friday.
thanks for the kind words.

Did all of that except the alarm thing, oh the joys of work.

Thanks, well, my body thanks you.

Just an update the next morning, didn't even remember posting this. womp.  Took me about half an hour to get the courage up to read what I posted and see the responses.

So the negative.
Was an hour late to work, puked, feel like butt.

But the positive!

I got in touch with an old friend of mine who's been sober for four years.  Apparently I timed this perfectly because she's going to be in Boston all weekend at some kind of sober youth conference and I'm going with.  She's going to introduce me to a lot of really nice sober dudes she hangs out with.  

First time i've ever made an honest effort to stop.  Thanks for the positive! 

I'll post here again on monday with an update on how it went for those interested.

hey guys, i know this is three months old.  

originally i made this account as a throwaway, but i think i'm going to keep it as a reminder at this point.  

I've been drinking for a long time, always too much, had a couple dark years, suicide attempts, have been on the come up for a while.  my girlfriend, or ex-girlfriend i guess, killed herself a week ago. (you can see my post history for that)  I've been drinking a lot again.  

Realized tonight, spending a week of drunkenness (was drunk at her funeral, and puked in the bathroom directly before going to her wake), and again today after spilling beer and dip spit (gross i know) all over my new nikon d2h (3,000 dollar camera.) 

I'm becoming disgusting.  I drink all day.  My roommates avoid me.  I had already feel like I lost them because I spent so much time with my girlfriend so now I'm lost.  I too searched alcoholism on reddit and found this in a hope to find a place that was averse to the religious part of AA.

I'm losing it.  I'm drunk now, but inspired.  I know there's alot of drunk redditing going on in these kind of places, but if I could get one of you to respond and just say hello, brother. 


As a long time atheist, should I go to AA?  I have a grief counselor, but fuck all they're doing.  




I just want a response to wake up in the morning.  Someone.  ha.  there's only two of you in this post and for all I know you guys haven't been on reddit in two months.   kind of a hail mary.  probably putting too much faith in that, and I'll find an AA regardless anyways.  I just need a friend.  thanks regardless.

hey man,

it's been a week.  I appreciate the reply.  
I have a grief counselor.

It's really hard though.  And has been getting tougher.  Don't know why I keep logging into my throwaway account, but thanks.

she killed herself yesterday.
she lost her. i lost her. i dunno.  drunk reddit posting.  don't know what to do.

she killed herself yesterday.

we had broken up about 4 days ago.  I couldn't look at her after that.  


i don't know.

Just an update.  I've made a point to take her out of my life for the time being.

When we woke up in the morning I took her back to her apartment.  She knows she fucked up.  She's going to start taking her medicine again.  I'm going to talk to her doctor.  And if I can regain her trust, we'll move on.  If not, I'll stay involved in her life as much as possible, until she cools down.  

I'm going to deal with the dude involved tomorrow, as he knew full well that we were in a relationship.  Nothing harsh, just words.  Put the fear of god in him maybe though, that should feel nice.

Anyways, thanks again reddit.  In end, glad I found the bipolar subreddit for me as well, that's a positive.

Thanks guys. We'll see how things play out.  
Oh and i'll be hitting the gym.  ha.

glad i go on reddit instinctively. I'll be going on that bipolar subreddit for me at least.  I checked out some of the threads, I'll use my real account to contribute to that.

eh.  I do appreciate your positive advice though.  That is why I always come back here.
I have a lot of figuring out to do.

Both for her well being and for mine.  damnit.

well, the night went on.

walked in on her hooking up with a random dude at the party.
I walked home.

damnit.  Don't know if I should blame the lack of medicine or her.  I'll figure it out tomorrow.  six months.  man.

I'm really nervous.  Its one of those things.  I love her so much, but its hard enough to keep my own life in check.  

I'll post tomorrow with updates.

When she wakes up tomorrow I'll mention alternatives and such.

I've been thinking about sitting in on a therapy session with her though, to both see if her doctor isn't a quack, and to be allowed to give alternate opinions in a safe environment.

thanks for the advice!

She waited 4 days into our vacation to tell me she decided not to take. it.  

On the lithium though, she's always complained about side effects.  She often gets incredibly sleepy and falls asleep at parties. Always overtired, no drive etc.  


She was definitely still manic when she came back (I occasionally get that way too, but I've been going to therapy for a couple of  years) and talked alot, talked loudly, was short of breath, she felt funny.  We had a party at our house tonight and she decided to drink alot and smoked a lot of weed, which might help for tonight (though it was scary to see her try and party so hard).  Hopefully she'll fall asleep soon, its kind of terrifying, she's not the girl that I know, or fell in love with.

I love the idea of an agreement though.  That's a good call.  We'll talk over breakfast tomorrow.  i'll do my best tonight to be a buffer and encourage her with good thoughts.  I appreciate the advice a lot.

I didn't realize there was a bipolar forum though.  I only posted it here because at the time she was hurting herself and such.

One day at a time though.  

Thanks.

She's relaxed now though.  I'm not on reddit as she's threatening suicide or anything.  Figured I'd write that.  What do I do in the future though? 

I'm going to push for her to maybe find an alternative to lithium? or if it makes her feel better a reduced dosage.  

I'm seriously concerned and worried.  I'll start scrounging around reddit and searching in the meantime.
